cues.text: Ready, ready, are you ready?
One more round of hide-and-seek.
Make this match a good match for me.
cues.translation: 이번 승부는 내가 즐겁게 해 줘

cues.text: I don’t need a friend who’s weak.
Oh my soldier, where are you hiding?
Mirrors within mirrors all around, and no reflection cast.
cues.translation: 거울 속 거울이 사방에 가득한데 비친 모습은 하나도 없어

cues.text: Your misguiding makes it exciting:
cues.translation: 네가 길을 헤매게 하니 더 신나

cues.text: I can’t even tell what I’m looking at!
Oh my soldier, where are you going?
I should know that this is the kind of place that can’t be left.
cues.translation: 여긴 떠날 수 없는 곳인 걸 알아야지

cues.text: Like fresh blood, once spilt, gets to flowing:
Our little game isn’t over yet!
( “Patterns… The patterns are so pretty!
Here’s another!  Can you find your way through this maze?
cues.translation: 여기 또 하나 이 미로를 빠져나갈 길을 찾겠어

cues.text: A maze like this sometimes gets a little tight and scary.
cues.translation: 이런 미로는 가끔 좁고 무서울 때도 있어

cues.text: And if you touch the edge, you’ll…
Well, don’t touch the edge, okay?  That’s part of the game!” )
cues.translation: 그러니까 가장자리는 건드리지 마 알았지 그것도 놀이의 일부야

cues.text: Seven colors~
My rainbow misses something still.
My favorite shade of scarlet will
Increase until I have my fill—
cues.translation: 내가 실컷 채울 때까지 짙어질 거야

cues.text: Lonely, lonely, I’ll be lonely,
If you leave me like before.
All forbidden in name only,
There’s no limit anymore.
Shame, for now, this playtime is ending;
cues.translation: 아쉬워라 이제 놀이 시간이 끝나 가

cues.text: My new toy is broken again, like everything I touch.
cues.translation: 내 새 장난감도 또 부서졌네 내가 만진 모든 것처럼

cues.text: If it snaps with such easy bending:
Well, I guess it was never worth that much!
Oh my soldier, where are you going?
Hungering for more, as the number dwindles down to one.
No fear showing, deep in un-knowing:
cues.translation: 겁은 보이지 않은 채 깊은 무지 속에서

cues.text: Glanced again, and then…there were none?
